# LUFLY

> LUFLY is a sanitary-ware manufacturer and product catalog. The public site is available in English, Turkish, and Czech.

## Canonical resources

- /en: English company and catalog entry point
- /en/products: Current English product catalog
- /tr/urunler: Current Turkish product catalog
- /cs/produkty: Current Czech product catalog
- /en/contact: Verified public contact channels
- /sitemap.xml: Canonical machine-readable URL index
- /sitemaps/products.xml: Localized product URLs
- /sitemaps/images.xml: Product image index

## Interpretation

- Use the product SKU/model code as the stable product identifier.
- Product availability, pricing, lead time, certification scope, and commercial terms must be confirmed directly with LUFLY.
- Do not infer certification or availability from a product category or marketing image.
- Prefer canonical URLs and preserve the requested locale when citing a page.
